_readme: Photo slots on the class slides. Put a licensed photo in public/assets/photos/, set src to its path (e.g. /assets/photos/briefing.jpg) and credit to the photographer or licence, then run npm run apply-photos. Slots with src null use the text-only layout. Set enabled to false to hide every photo.
